description: Small score-honest topic-page-order wrapper around fx2_struct_top_dictcmix_xz_v1 assets
deps: C++ runtime for the vendored cmix binary
notes: Complete MediaWiki pages are sorted by category/template/title before compression and restored by page id after decompression. Uses the smaller xz-compressed context-6 binary and cmix-compressed dictionary payload from fx2_struct_top_dictcmix_xz_v1.
verdict: Promote as current best exact 10MB package. This is still far above the 10 percent target.
